title: User Registration
description: Verify user registration with valid details.
testDescription: A new user registers an account using valid information.
prerequisites: User must not have an existing account with the same email.
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to registration page.
2. Enter valid name, email, and password.
3. Submit the registration form.
expectedResult: User receives a confirmation email and is redirected to the welcome page.
additionalFields: Data Privacy Compliance: Ensure PII is encrypted during transmission.

title: Product Search and Filtering
description: Verify product search and filtering functionality.
testDescription: A user searches for a product and applies filters to narrow down results.
prerequisites: Product catalog must be populated with various products.
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the search bar.
2. Enter a product keyword.
3. Apply filters such as price range and category.
expectedResult: Search results are displayed according to the applied filters.
additionalFields: Cross-browser Compatibility: Test on Chrome, Firefox, Safari.

title: Shopping Cart Management
description: Verify adding and removing items from the shopping cart.
testDescription: A user adds items to the cart and removes them.
prerequisites: User must be logged in and have selected products.
stepsToPerform:
1. Add a product to the cart.
2. View cart.
3. Remove a product from the cart.
expectedResult: Cart updates correctly with added and removed items.
additionalFields: Boundary Value Analysis: Test with maximum allowed quantity.

title: Checkout Process
description: Verify checkout process with payment gateway integration.
testDescription: A user completes a purchase using a valid payment method.
prerequisites: User must have items in the cart and a valid payment method.
stepsToPerform:
1. Proceed to checkout.
2. Enter shipping details.
3. Select payment method and complete payment.
expectedResult: Order is confirmed and payment is processed successfully.
additionalFields: High-risk Edge Cases: Test with invalid payment details.

title: Order Confirmation and Notification
description: Verify order confirmation and notification system.
testDescription: A user receives confirmation and notification after placing an order.
prerequisites: User must have completed a purchase.
stepsToPerform:
1. Complete an order.
2. Check email for confirmation.
3. Check order status in user profile.
expectedResult: User receives an email confirmation and order status is updated.
additionalFields: Data Integrity: Ensure order details are accurate in the database.

title: User Profile Management
description: Verify user can update their profile information.
testDescription: A user updates their profile details such as name, email, and password.
prerequisites: User must be logged in and have an existing profile.
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to user profile page.
2. Update name, email, and password fields.
3. Save changes.
expectedResult: Profile is updated successfully and changes are reflected immediately.
additionalFields: Data Privacy Compliance: Ensure updated PII is encrypted during transmission.

title: Role-based Access Control
description: Verify access control for admin and user roles.
testDescription: Ensure that users with different roles have appropriate access to features.
prerequisites: User accounts with admin and regular user roles must exist.
stepsToPerform:
1. Log in as an admin.
2. Attempt to access admin dashboard.
3. Log in as a regular user.
4. Attempt to access admin dashboard.
expectedResult: Admin can access admin dashboard; regular user cannot.
additionalFields: Security Compliance: Ensure unauthorized access is prevented.

title: Data Privacy and Security Compliance
description: Verify secure data transmission and storage.
testDescription: Ensure all sensitive data is transmitted and stored securely.
prerequisites: System must be configured with SSL/TLS for secure transmission.
stepsToPerform:
1. Perform a transaction involving PII.
2. Monitor data transmission.
3. Check data storage for encryption.
expectedResult: Data is encrypted during transmission and storage.
additionalFields: Compliance Check: Adhere to GDPR and CCPA regulations.

title: Error Handling and User Feedback
description: Verify system provides appropriate error messages and feedback.
testDescription: Ensure users receive clear error messages for invalid actions.
prerequisites: System must have error handling mechanisms in place.
stepsToPerform:
1. Attempt to register with an existing email.
2. Attempt to checkout with an expired card.
3. Attempt to access restricted area without permission.
expectedResult: User receives clear and informative error messages.
additionalFields: User Experience: Ensure messages are user-friendly and actionable.

title: Integration with External Systems
description: Verify integration with payment gateways and inventory management.
testDescription: Ensure seamless integration with external systems for transactions and inventory updates.
prerequisites: System must be integrated with a payment gateway and inventory management system.
stepsToPerform:
1. Complete a purchase using an external payment gateway.
2. Verify transaction status.
3. Check inventory update post-purchase.
expectedResult: Transaction is successful and inventory is updated accordingly.
additionalFields: Integration Testing: Ensure real-time data synchronization with external systems.

title: Session Timeout Management
description: Verify user session timeout and re-login requirement.
testDescription: Ensure that user sessions expire after a period of inactivity and require re-login.
prerequisites: User must be logged in and have an active session.
stepsToPerform:
1. Log in to the user account.
2. Remain inactive for the session timeout period.
3. Attempt to perform an action after timeout.
expectedResult: User is logged out automatically and prompted to log in again.
additionalFields: Security Compliance: Ensure session timeout is configurable and secure.

title: Invalid Promotional Code Handling
description: Verify system response to invalid or expired promotional codes.
testDescription: Ensure users receive appropriate feedback when entering invalid or expired promo codes.
prerequisites: User must have items in the cart and access to promo code entry.
stepsToPerform:
1. Proceed to checkout.
2. Enter an invalid or expired promo code.
3. Attempt to apply the code.
expectedResult: System displays an error message indicating the promo code is invalid or expired.
additionalFields: User Experience: Ensure error messages are clear and informative.

title: Cross-Device Compatibility
description: Verify e-commerce platform compatibility across various devices.
testDescription: Ensure the platform functions correctly on different devices such as mobile, tablet, and desktop.
prerequisites: Access to multiple devices with internet connectivity.
stepsToPerform:
1. Access the platform on a mobile device.
2. Perform a product search and add items to the cart.
3. Repeat steps on a tablet and desktop.
expectedResult: Platform displays and functions correctly across all devices.
additionalFields: Responsive Design: Ensure UI adapts to different screen sizes.

title: Order Status Transition
description: Verify correct state transitions for order statuses.
testDescription: Ensure order status changes correctly from Pending to Confirmed, Shipped, and Delivered.
prerequisites: User must have placed an order.
stepsToPerform:
1. Place an order and check initial status.
2. Update order status to Confirmed.
3. Update order status to Shipped.
4. Update order status to Delivered.
expectedResult: Order status transitions correctly through all stages.
additionalFields: State Transition Testing: Validate each status change triggers appropriate actions.

title: Secure Payment Processing
description: Verify secure processing of payments through external gateways.
testDescription: Ensure payment details are securely transmitted and processed via external gateways.
prerequisites: User must have items in the cart and a valid payment method.
stepsToPerform:
1. Proceed to checkout.
2. Select an external payment gateway.
3. Enter payment details and complete the transaction.
expectedResult: Payment is processed securely and order is confirmed.
additionalFields: Security Compliance: Ensure payment data is encrypted during transmission.
